isla (Design): Quick thread: small UX pattern idea for SSO-managed roles in the Invite & Roles pages. Current approach hides too much behind tooltips. Proposal: an inline help pill next to role labels that expands in-place with short copy and a small 'Open provisioning' link. Sketch: https://redwood.app/s/help-pill-proto :sparkles: rob (PM): +1. The goal: reduce support tickets where org admins assume roles vanished. We talked about modal dialogs earlier, but an inline pill is less disruptive for quick invites. Also helps in Roles matrix rows. teo (FE): implementation thoughts: make the pill a

SSO-managed role assignments

Your identity provider controls which role invited users receive. To change mappings, update provisioning in your IdP.

Open provisioning settings
``` rob (PM): please make the link open in a new tab and add the toast. Also, add a tiny note in the pill copy for Roles matrix: "(default mapping applies)" to set expectations. isla (Design): will update mocks with microcopy and spacing token. Also add color token for the pill so it passes 4.5:1 contrast. infra-bot: deployed branch feat/help-pill-ssoroles to staging at 2026-03-28T13:45Z :white_check_mark: teo (FE): PR opened: https://git.redwood/PR/5621 — includes aria attributes and tests for keyboard interactions. Nina, can you quick-run the axe scan on staging? nina (A11y): will do a quick sweep after lunch and report any failures. If all good, I'll thumbs-up for merge. rob (PM): thanks team. If the pill reduces even a few support tickets, it's a win. We'll measure ticket volume after rollout and iterate.
